user_instruction: 对于结果进行处理，探究一些深度问题和反常问题。设置后台自动执行运行不要中断
scope: Analyze and independently test the completed Worker B anomalous Hessians; bounded diagnostic continuation of the same allocation.
independent_question: Do the saved imaginary modes represent actual local potential-energy curvature or numerical derivative/response inconsistency?
hypotheses: Incomplete or inaccurate electronic response in analytic Hessian
predeclared_diagnostics: Independent array, atom-order, rigid-body and mode-localization audit.
Double-step central differences of full fresh gradients and energies along saved Cartesian-normalized modes.
Water vibration and whole-molecule translation software controls.
Grid-level and gradient-grid-response sensitivities on the same original geometries.

decision_rules.derivative_consistency: Compare analytic Hq and qTHq with central full-gradient derivative and energy curvature at h=0.005 and 0.01 Bohr.
decision_rules.followup_flag: Opposite signs or >10% relative curvature difference trigger further investigation, not an automatic bug declaration.
decision_rules.true_negative_curvature: Requires reproducible negative finite-gradient and energy curvatures across both step sizes; this does not certify a full stationary minimum.
decision_rules.quadrature_limitation: Every displaced geometry rebuilds atom-centered grids. gradient_grid_response=False is not the exact derivative of a common fixed quadrature functional; disagreement alone does not identify a Hessian bug.
decision_rules.electronic_tolerance: Followup SCF tolerance=1e-10; original SCF tolerance=1e-8. This is a recorded numerical sensitivity, not a relabeling of the historical result.

preservation: Original outputs, science source, manifests, costs and checkpoints remain unchanged.
not_claimed: New independent plant or batch data
